column3: MT 2:3. Close to the Hebrew; “Shown Compassion” (Ruhamah) is rendered “Mercy is shown.”
MT 2:4. Close to the Hebrew; “conduct a case” is rendered “Bring charges,” and “from her face” “from her sight.”
MT 2:5. Close to the Hebrew; “I will exhibit her” is rendered “expose her.”
MT 2:6. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 2:7. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 2:8. Close to the Hebrew; “I will wall up her wall” is rendered “wall her in.”
MT 2:9. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 2:10. Close to the Hebrew; “which they made into Baal” is rendered “Which they prepared for Baal.”
MT 2:11. Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “Given” (“Given to cover her nakedness”).
MT 2:12. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 2:13. Close to the Hebrew; “all her gaiety” is rendered “all her mirth.”
MT 2:14. Close to the Hebrew; “a thicket” is rendered “a forest.”
MT 2:15. Close to the Hebrew; “I will visit on her” is rendered “I will punish her,” and “her rings” “her earrings.”
MT 2:16. Close to the Hebrew; “I will speak to her heart” is rendered “speak comfort to her.”
MT 2:17. Close to the Hebrew; “she will answer there” is rendered “She shall sing there.”
MT 2:18. Close to the Hebrew; “my Baal” is rendered “My Master.”
MT 2:19. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 2:20. Close to the Hebrew; “bow and sword and battle” is rendered “Bow and sword of battle,” and “the land” “the earth.”
MT 2:21. Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” is rendered “lovingkindness.”
MT 2:22. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 2:23. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 2:24. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 2:25. Close to the Hebrew; the names “Lo-Ruhamah” and “Lo-Ammi” are rendered “her who had not obtained mercy” and “those who were not My people,” and “the land” “the earth.”
